title: Plan for Irregular Costs
blurb: Turn annual bills and planned purchases into monthly targets.
cards: Annual fees, school supplies, gifts and routine maintenance may arrive only once in a while, but you can often anticipate them.
Divide the target across the time left
Estimate the total and divide by the number of months before it is due. Save that amount regularly in a clearly named pot or category.
A 360 bill due in 9 months needs 40 per month, before any interest or price changes. Starting earlier lowers the monthly amount. Recheck the estimate if the cost changes.
A 240 annual cost is due in 12 months. What monthly amount reaches the target?
A sinking fund is only useful for emergencies.
It is also useful for known future costs, planned purchases and annual bills.
You already missed the ideal start date. What is sensible?
Work out what is affordable for the time left and adjust the plan
Use the time remaining and your real budget to choose a workable contribution.
